messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Adult Dose for Diabetic Nephropathy:
Initial dose: 50 mg orally once a day Maximum dose: 100 mg orally once a day Comments: -If hypertensive patients with left ventricular hypertrophy or type 2 diabetic nephropathy patients require titration from initial dose, increase to 100 mg orally once a day. -Antihypertension is substantially present within 1 week but in some studies the maximal effect occurred in 3 to 6 weeks. Uses: -Treatment of hypertension. -To reduce the risk of stroke in patients with hypertension and left ventricular hypertrophy. -Treatment of diabetic nephropathy with an elevated serum creatinine and proteinuria (urinary albumin to creatinine ratio 300 mg/g or greater) in patients with type 2 diabetes and a history of hypertension.
Usual Adult Dose for Hypertension:
Triplet: ["Losartan", "has effect timeline", "antihypertension substantially present within 1 week"]

The relation 'has effect timeline' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug exhibits the effect or outcome described by the object entity within a specific timeframe.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
B. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
C. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
